div.div: 5 تأدّب He learned, or was taught, what is termed أَدَب [or good discipline of the mind and manners, &c.; i. e. he became, or was rendered, well-disciplined, well-educated, well-bred, wellmannered, polite, instructed in polite accomplishments, &c.]; as also ↓ استأدب . (S, Mgh, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
